summary:
No plan written for w194: the research notes don't cover everything the work-item accepts.
w194 now accepts supervision#r120, r121, r75 and r105, and lists the deprecated @r75 PARTIAL scenario (feature:1050) under ## Retires (the answer, reading a).
The research notes (1-research/notes.md) were written when w194 accepted only r120 and r121. They say nothing about the r75 Outline (feature:1058, the row 'w1 is withdrawn and w2 is withdrawn / is not measured') or the r105 Outline (feature:1454, rows is set done / is not set done). They don't say why those are red, what code holds the at-least-one-green condition for measure initiative (r75) or set_done (r105), which steps are missing (e.g. the Given 'i1's kept branch review lists nothing to fix now, and i1's measurement and analysis record are committed on the initiative branch'), or which tests break.
w192's implement report says the suite failures are r121, r75 and r105 scenarios, so the r75 and r105 Outlines are red. w192's plan put the at-least-one-green clause into the shared done condition, and the notes don't say whether that work is in this base.
r120, r121 and the retirement could be planned from the notes as they stand: drop the DONE condition in supervise_analysis.py lists_nothing; add the r121 Given and the r120 Then; retire feature:1050 and its step with features retire.
But r75 may need an edit to scripts/supervise.py pull_through, which has 29 lines of room. Planning that from source would be research, so the research stage should be re-run for all four accepted requirements.
questions: The research notes for w194 cover only supervision#r120 and r121. The work-item also accepts supervision#r75 and r105, whose new Outlines (features/supervision.feature:1058 and :1454) are red, as w192's implement report says. Re-run research for w194 to cover r75 and r105: why each row is red today, the code that carries the at-least-one-green condition for measure initiative (r75) and set_done (r105), whether w192's change to the shared done condition is in this base, the missing steps, and the tests these changes break.
